name: Rho Geminorum
description: A naked-eye star 18.0 parsecs away, 1.7 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 58946: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.853 +/- 0.014 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.655 +/- 0.028

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 58946: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 1.355 +/- 0.013

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 58946: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 6899 +/- 63

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 58946: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 55.41 +/- 0.25 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 18 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.7 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.853 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.655 solar radii and 6,899 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 58946: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
